note: Fixed before any model run (decision-criteria.md). B and S differ only in the ASC package installed into the sample project (release.json). Everything else is the same in both conditions: the case files, the prompt, the tools, the browser MCP container and allowlist proxy (#1807 env/), the isolation (#1814), the model and the per-trial budget. The sample project is built per trial: case files + FONTS.md, git init, ASC installed from the condition's tarball with `project-assets --register-claude-skill --apply --adopt-read-trigger claude-md@...` in a dedicated worktree (as #1814 condition I and v05/USAGE.md), fast-forwarded to main.
modelNote: The `sonnet` alias, as #1807 (generator) and #1814. The resolved id (init event) is recorded per trial.

budget.note: Owner cap 40 USD (Host-computed total_cost_usd). One ledger for generation and the Fable rankings. A generation trial or a ranking session starts only when ledger total + its reservation <= capUsd - safetyMarginUsd. perTrialUsd is --max-budget-usd of every generation trial (#1807 used 1.5). A ranking session is reserved at rankingReserveUsd and settled with its Host cost; Codex reports no Host cost (recorded as missing, as #1807).

promptNote: #1807の手順を指示しない依頼文（docs/evidence/からの相対path）。両条件・全ケースで同じ。
order: Sequential, one trial at a time (ledger lock). Round r = 1..3; within a round the cases in the order ui03-dashboard, ui07-bus-mobile, ui04-parts-search; within a case B then S in odd rounds and S then B in even rounds.

B.label: 現行ASC（release v0.5.109、利用者の手順で導入し、CLAUDE.mdの案内文を採用）

S.label: 候補（Bと同じ手順。違いはimplementation.mdとjourneys.mdの追記だけ）
